name: grasp
description: Review what your coding agent did, decision by decision.
long_description: The agent records each decision (what, why, files, risk) and shows real before/after behavior: grasp runs a command on the old code and the new code. Reviewers approve or reject each decision on a local page (grasp serve), and rejections come back to the agent through get_review_feedback.

project.title: Project folder
project.description: The git repository the agent works in. grasp keeps its notes in .grasp there.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision before making the changes that carry it out.

tools.name: show_behavior
tools.description: Run a command on the old and the new code and show reviewers both outputs.

tools.name: get_review_feedback
tools.description: Get reviewer verdicts and comments on earlier decisions.
